titre: King and pawn. Only one move wins. ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
King and pawn vs king, White to move: only 1.Ke5! wins (opposition), e.g. 1...Kd7 2.Kd5 Ke7 3.Kc6 Ke6 4.d5+ Ke5 5.d6 Ke4 6.d7 Kd3 7.d8=Q+. The six other moves only draw, including 1.d5? Kd6 (Stockfish 16). Composed position. Would you have found it? 👇
